n: Rope-based neural network role play (Salomey Addo)
t: A role play where students and ropes act out a small neural network.
steps: Get the activity materials from the Teaching about AI seminar page.
Print the cards and role sheets.
Gather enough ropes for the connections.
Gather ten students for one network.
Give the supervisor the data table.
Assign the input, hidden and output roles.
Run forward propagation first and then the simplified backpropagation.
